source: Comune di Bergamo, Comune Bergamo - Graduatoria dei nomi, 2025 resident data on the Regione Lombardia portal
geographicScope: Residents of Bergamo municipality, including Italian and foreign citizenship; not a national Italian frequency sample.
licenseScope: This exact official dataset metadata declares CC0_10 and links the CC0 legal text. The dataset owner and table author are Comune di Bergamo. The attribution metadata field identifies provenance, not an additional attribution condition. No portal-wide or third-party licence inference is used.
attribution: Comune di Bergamo via Open Data Regione Lombardia, 2025. Independently selected and formatted by this library.
selection: All published top-100 given-name rows for each explicit sex and citizenship category in 2025. Map Maschi to male and Femmine to female. Retain every distinct given-name string after combining the disjoint Italiani and Stranieri citizenship categories within each recorded sex. Order by descending sum of published counts, then UTF-8 spelling. Missing counterparts in truncated/suppressed categories are unknown; sums can be lower bounds, not complete city population frequencies. Do not combine different years. Generation is uniform.
display: Normalize NFC and trim outer whitespace. Display each letter sequence with its first source letter followed by lowercase letters; retain separators and source apostrophes (including trailing apostrophes used in some spellings) without inventing accents or internal capitalization.
